sloka: स्वर्गेऽपि खलु रामस्य कुशलं दैवतैरह्म् ।प्रत्यादेशादभिहितं धारयिष्ये कथं बत ॥२-१३-६॥
transliteration: svarge'pi khalu rāmasya kuśalaṁ daivatairahm ।pratyādeśādabhihitaṁ dhārayiṣye kathaṁ bata ॥2-13-6॥

translations.english: Even in heaven when the gods enquire about the welfare of Rama how will I convince them about his banishment repudiating the fact? What a catastrophe
translations.hindi: उनके शारीर में बराह के रुधिर के समान लाल, पबित्र और , सुगन्ध वाला चन्दन लगा हुआ है
